 "command": "cat > programs/task-bc35d080.py <<'PY'
def transform(grid):
    """Stamp every occurrence of the colored template into matching zeros."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    colored = [(r, c, grid[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (0, 4, 9)]
    # ARC examples use a two-color noise field; the unique non-background color
    # defines the stamp. Find its bounding box and local colored-cell mask.
    if not colored:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    color = colored[0][2]
    points = [(r, c) for r, c, v in colored if v == color]
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in points), max(r for r, c in points)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in points), max(c for r, c in points)
    mask = [(r-r0, c-c0) for r, c in points]
    mh, mw = r1-r0+1, c1-c0+1
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for top in range(h-mh+1):
        for left in range(w-mw+1):
            if all(grid[top+dr][left+dc] == 0 for dr, dc in mask):
                for dr, dc in mask:
                    out[top+dr][left+dc] = color
    return out
PY
